check1_cello_in_embellishment.question: Is cello/cellophane/lamination classified under the Embellishment capability?
check1_cello_in_embellishment.finding: YES. QB's qb_capability_tag tags celloglaze film finishes (Matt cello, Gloss/Velvet/Soft-touch/Anti-scuff celloglaze, Matte/Gloss film) as 'Embellishment'. Plain 'Cello' -> Specialty Finishing; 'Matt laminate 6yr' -> Wide Format; but the celloglaze variants -> Embellishment.
check1_cello_in_embellishment.verdict: CONFIRMED. 77.7% of 'embellishment buyers' qualify only via cello/coating; removing cello drops soft-cover->embellishment from 63% to 16%.

check2_withinjob_finishes.question: Does 'buys embellishment' count customers who only apply finishes WITHIN other jobs?
check2_withinjob_finishes.finding: YES. Of genuine-embellishment buyers (foil/UV/emboss), almost all apply it as a finish within book/sheet jobs, not as a standalone embellishment product.
check2_withinjob_finishes.verdict: CONFIRMED. 166 of 169 genuine-embellishment buyers are within-job finishers; standalone embellishment is near-zero (3 companies), sc->emb standalone = 0.2%.

check3_hardcover_wideformat_artifact.question: Is hardcover->wideformat actually cover printing (part of the book), not a cross-sell?
check3_hardcover_wideformat_artifact.finding: NO. WF operation_names for hardcover+WF companies are signage/large-format (Printing, Zund cutting, banners, decals, pull-ups, mounting, laminate) - ZERO cover/case/cloth/linen ops. Only 9.1% of their WF jobs share a job_no with hardcover (bundled projects, not covers).
check3_hardcover_wideformat_artifact.verdict: REFUTED. The 72% hardcover->wideformat is a genuine co-purchase (lift ~2), not a cover-printing artifact. Reps' intuition is wrong on this one.

soft_cover_to_embellishment.verdict: CONFIRMED. Cello-removed 15.7% lands at the top of the reps' 10-15% range; standalone is ~0%.

hard_cover_to_wide_format.verdict: NOT CONFIRMED. Even removing same-job WF only drops 72% -> 57%, nowhere near 10%; WF is real signage.

check5_recent_jobmanager_vs_customer_am.question: Is recent job manager (am_job) the truth vs unreliable am_customer?
check5_recent_jobmanager_vs_customer_am.verdict: CONFIRMED (partial). 6 of 50 change under recency-weighted am_job. 3 are the departed-AM accounts already reassigned (Jet->Nic, Jefferies->Ehab, Forsight->Nic) - which exactly matches the recent-job manager, validating that fix. 3 active-AM discrepancies: Ball & Doggett (Ehab->Kenneth, 4 recent jobs), SCCO Studio (Ehab->Linda), Tribe Studio (Linda->Ehab, weak tie).

fixes_needed.embellishment_definition: YES - high priority. 25 of 50 cards pitch Embellishment; the soft-cover->embellishment rule falls from 63% to 15.7% once cello is removed - BELOW the 25% confidence floor. Most embellishment cross-sell pitches are a cello artifact and would not survive a corrected definition. Recommend: reclassify celloglaze out of Embellishment (it is a lamination finish, ~Specialty Finishing), then regenerate the cards.
fixes_needed.am_assignment_basis: CONSIDER - switch the assignment basis from am_customer-mode to recency-weighted am_job; 3 active cards (Ball & Doggett, SCCO, Tribe) would re-owner, plus it independently confirms the departed-AM reassignments.
